final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT link_to_member AS m, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.m AS m, s1.s AS s, s1.s * 1.0 / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL AND s2.t <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.m, s3.s, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a) SELECT SUM(s), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
